proof_availability.classification_scope: The product-rooted PNA growth/read/reactivation proposal still needs an actual bond-discriminating reader and compatible separated reset. The earlier reader model retains P_step=p*v/(p+w+h*alpha), h=1-p-w, only when every harmless failure restores the same parent. The new two-state imine/hydrolyzed-donor model has exact slow loss gamma(u)=2*r*u/[r+c+u+sqrt((r+c+u)^2-4*r*u)], with 1<=gamma(u_w)/gamma(u_c)<=u_w/u_c for fixed r,c>0 and u_w>=u_c>0. The exponential effective-hazard model separately gives a finite damage-limited optimal wait and eventual correct-stage probability p/(p+w+d). Composition-only full mass cannot certify sequence order: 256 canonical tetramers have only35 composition classes. Reversible recognition followed by amide-forming commitment is a candidate, not an acquired compatible PNA operation.
